Ideogram (2026-09 redesign): - The redesign dropped the `aspect-ratio-config-container` and `generate-button` test ids. Recraft: - poll_recraft no longer hands back the image bytes. It replies with a JSON manifest naming image ids, and the browser then fetches the pixels from a signed img.recraft.ai URL — so every generation died on "poll_recraft response has no multipart boundary ('application/json')" even though the image had rendered. Accept both reply shapes (_parse_poll) and read the bytes off the img.recraft.ai response, preferring the raw original over the resized @avif variants. - Locate the model picker's vendor flyout by its data-testid: the row's accessible name collides with an unrelated model row, so the old role/name lookup grabbed that row and never opened the flyout. - Deselect any canvas layer before touching the settings controls; while a layer is selected an invisible overlay swallows those clicks. - Wrap Playwright errors as BackendError, matching Ideogram. README updated to match the Recraft flow and its new timeout messages. Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)
